name: Interstate S-1 Cadet
variants: S-1B1 / S-1B2 (150 hp; Arctic Tern bush version)
summary: Tandem two-seat, strut-braced high-wing taildragger of wood-and-fabric construction with robust oleo-spring gear; the S-1B2 became the Arctic Tern bush plane.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
Wooden wing structure with fabric covering
engines: Single flat-four in a rounded cowl
fuselage: Sturdy oleo / spring main gear with a tailwheel
tail: Conventional fin and rudder on a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Tandem two-seat high-wing taildragger with sturdy oleo main gear
Strut-braced wing over a rounded fabric fuselage
Cub-like layout with a more robust undercarriage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Interstate has sturdier oleo-sprung main gear; the Cub's gear is light and bungee-sprung.
Both are tandem Cub-like taildraggers; the Interstate has heavier oleo gear and a more robust build.
